label: U-Neckline
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Product photograph of a light-blue waistcoat on an invisible/ghost form over a white shirt and navy tie. The neckline is unmistakably a deep U: a single continuous arc from armhole to armhole with no V intersection, no notch and no lapel - exactly the 'V intersection replaced by an arc' the description specifies, and wide enough that the arc radius reads roughly 9-11 cm. Also visible: double-breasted wrap front with 6 buttons (two columns of 3), two jetted waist pockets, and an asymmetric pointed hem.
